Definition: Thin and lightweight premium laptop; originally an Intel-defined category
Main trade-off: Limited upgradeability and sustained heavy-workload performance

Definition: General term for a laptop; not a separate performance class
Main advantage: Wide choice of sizes and specifications
Main trade-off: Capabilities depend on the individual model

Definition: Touchscreen laptop with a folding hinge for laptop and tablet modes
Best suited for: Handwritten notes; presentations; drawing with a compatible pen
Main trade-off: Hinge complexity; pen support varies; less convenient than a dedicated tablet

Definition: Laptop optimized for games; typically powerful graphics and cooling
Main trade-off: Often heavier; louder; shorter battery life under load

Definition: Laptop designed for demanding professional applications; may offer certified drivers
Main advantage: Professional software support and sustained performance

Definition: Small low-cost low-power laptop; mainly a historical category
Main trade-off: Limited processing power; small screen and keyboard
